newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Oct 10.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - Oct 10.

text.p: * Olin Corp said it plans to spin off its ordnance and aerospace units. The company also said it will sell its isocyanates businesses to ARCO Chemical Co for $565 million, and sell its polyol, glycol and surfactants units.
Olin also announced it would buy back up to 10 percent of its shares and declared a 2-for-1 stock split. Olin shares closed at 84-1/8. ARCO Chemical closed at 49-1/8.
* Enron Corp announced third quarter earnings of $0.48 per share versus $0.40 last year.
* Gulfstream Aerospace Corp's initial public offering priced at $24 per share, at the high end of its expected range.

* Altera Corp reported third quarter earnings of $0.53 per share versus $0.52 a year ago, and VideoServer Inc reported third quarter earnings of $0.17 per share versus $0.08 last year. Shares in both companies rose in after-hours trading. Altera closed at 53-7/8 and VideoServer closed at 38.
* NationsBank Corp said it filed a $3 billion shelf registration. Shares closed at 88-3/8.
* Paracelsus Healthcare Corp said its earnings will be well below expectations and it may have to restate results for the last three quarters. Shares closed at 10-1/8.
